reason: I would not hand a new website my resume and my data just to see if it works. I rarely pay for anything, and I already have one YouTuber's free playlists that I trust more than a site I have never heard of.
objection: I do not know who runs this site or what happens to my resume after I upload it. The 'delete everything with one button' line helps, but I still have to believe it.
would_change_my_mind: A creator I already follow using it and telling me it worked for them, so I trust the people behind it before I give them my resume.
